text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT DETECTED — prod inference latency spike across eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Severity: Sev2. Pager triggered. War room: https://warroom.redwood.ai/room/2405551234

Alice N: On it, joining war room now. Can someone confirm customer impact? Are embeddings/requests failing or just delayed?

Sam K: I'm paged. I'll take incident owner unless someone else needs it. Starting triage: checking autoscaler logs and recent deploys.

Jess L: I see elevated 95th ms and many token timeouts to model-serve nodes in eu-west-1. Errors look like transient OOMs on some pods. No deploys in last 20m.

Ravi P: Confirmed — autoscaler attempted to add nodes but they didn't join cluster (kube join errors). Potential networking flake to the node bootstrap. Customer impact: some requests are timing out (~5-10% of requests), others are delayed 2-6s.

Sam K: Assigning owner -> Sam K. War room link pinned above. On-call: @SRE Pager please confirm you received the page and stand ready for node-level work.

SRE Pager: received :white_check_mark: I'm in the war room and SSHing into the bootstrap logs. Notifying cloud infra to check VPC provisioning.

Alice N: Preparation for customer comms: draft status page note and a customer-facing blurb in case we need to update public status. Draft below — please iterate quickly.

Jess L: +1 to post an interim status if impact >5% for >10m. We should include affected regions, mitigation steps, and ETA for next update.

Alice N: DRAFT status page update (copy/paste):
```
We are investigating increased inference latency and intermittent request timeouts in eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Our engineering team has identified nodes failing to join the serving cluster due to a provisioning error and is actively restoring capacity. We are working to failover traffic and restore normal throughput. Next update: in 15 minutes or earlier.
Affected customers: most hosted API requests routed to eu-west-1/us-west-2. No evidence of data loss. We will provide a detailed post-incident report.
```

Sam K: Looks good. For immediate customer notifications (email/webhook), shorten to one sentence + link to status page. Example:
```
We're investigating higher-than-normal inference latency and timeouts for some requests in eu-west-1 and us-west-2. See status.redwood.ai/2405551234 for updates.
```

Ravi P: Mitigation plan being executed: 1) stop routing new traffic to affected node pool, 2) drain and recreate failed nodes with fallback AMI, 3) increase warm standby capacity in other regions, 4) enable short-term routing policy to prefer us-east-1. If step 2 fails, we'll scale up Dedicated fallback pool.

Sam K: Action items:
- Sam K: lead triage + coordinate cloud infra (working).
- SRE Pager: complete node recreates and confirm kube joins — target 10m.
- Jess L: prepare and post status page update once we have mitigation started.
- Alice N: draft customer email, prepare internal exec note.

Jess L: Posted interim status page update. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2405551234 :link:

Alice N: Customer email prepped; holding send until Sam gives green. Template saved to drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/incident-2405551234/customer-notice-draft.md

SRE Pager: Node recreate step completed on 3/4 affected availability zones, kube join now healthy. Observability shows reduced token timeouts. Continuing to monitor for 10m.

Sam K: Good work. Set next update in 10 minutes. If errors drop below 1% and p95 latency returns to baseline, we'll start recovery handoff.

Ravi P: Noting for postmortem: consider adding a second fallback for node bootstrap (cached AMI + prejoined snapshot) to reduce recovery time.

Alice N: Internal comms draft for engineering and support teams: short checklist + war room link + owner + public status link — ready to share when we hand off.

Sam K: Handing to Ravi for monitoring and follow-up after stabilization. Owner transfer: Sam K -> Ravi P at 2405551299. Sam out.

Ravi P: Taking over incident owner. Monitoring in war room, will coordinate RCA and customer comms going forward.

incident-bot: Incident 2405551234 severity reduced to Sev3 — customer impact contained; next update scheduled at 2405551359.

Alice N: Thanks everyone. I'll draft the post-incident email and start an internal incident summary template. If we need a customer notification send, I'll ping ops for approval. :thumbsup:
